main_conclusion: Murray's Method 2 explicitly substitutes (TMS)2Se for the Method 1 phosphine-selenide precursor. It is a short modification-by-reference, not an independently quantified complete CdSe protocol. Verified precursor literature must remain separate records.

murray_statement.meaning: Prepared (TMS)2Se and (BDMS)2Te using literature references3a and4; stored both at -35 C in a drybox.

citation_chain.verified_mapping: Reference3a directly provides a TMS2Se solution-preparation example. Its own General section cites Detty1982 and Liotta1978 for silyl-selenium/tellurium reagent methods. Thus do not claim ref3a is exclusively selenium and ref4 exclusively tellurium.

scope_of_method1_inheritance.explicit_reference: Method2 replaces the phosphine chalcogenide precursors in Method1.
scope_of_method1_inheritance.what_can_be_described: Shared hot-coordinating-medium/injection/growth outline and the separately reported general nanocrystal workup, clearly marked as linked Method1/common-procedure context.
scope_of_method1_inheritance.what_cannot_be_claimed: A new exact TMS2Se mass, molarity, stock volume, thermal history or sample-specific yield not stated in Method2.
scope_of_method1_inheritance.parent_numeric_fields: If 50 g TOPO, Method1 cadmium solution, bath preparation or common workup volumes are displayed, tag them as inherited/reference context, not independently reported CdSe Method2 parameters.

workup.status: General reported crystallite workup can be linked; no independent Method2 run/yield is documented.
workup.outline: 10-mL reaction aliquot cooled to about60C;20mL methanol and centrifuge retain flocculate;25mL1-butanol and centrifuge retain clear supernatant/discard gray byproduct;25mL methanol reflocculation;50mL methanol rinse;vacuum dry. Optional endpoint-based size selection.
workup.yield_note: Approximately300mg capped CdSe is a reported aliquot-workup outcome, not an independently confirmed Method2 yield.
